title: Employees must select a benefit plan before completing onboarding
description: As an Employee, I want the onboarding wizard to require a benefit plan selection before I can finish, so that I don't accidentally skip enrollment and end up without coverage.
raw_notes: Came out of the Growth-tier tenant pilot; two employees at Acme Corp completed onboarding without benefits selected because Finish was clickable early. Needs to be blocked in the UI, not just server-side validated.

analysis_confidence.rationale: AC-1 through AC-3 have explicit observable outcomes and matching wiki rules; AC-4 is explicitly classified out of functional automation scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Employee mid-onboarding with no BenefitPlan selected, when they view the wizard, then the Finish button is disabled.
Given an Employee selects a BenefitPlan belonging to their own Tenant, when the selection completes, then the Finish button becomes enabled.
Given a Growth-tier Tenant, when the Employee opens the plan dropdown, then only BenefitPlans belonging to that Tenant are listed (no cross-tenant leakage).
Given the wizard is fully filled out, when the Employee views the summary screen, then the layout reads clearly and matches the approved Figma design.
